verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail has a public pricing page that describes plan tiers and features such as scanning, forwarding and unlimited cloud storage. The check-deposit page says it is billed per deposit with no setup or monthly fees. However, the evidence shows no actual dollar amounts, scan allowances or per-item fee schedule, so completeness is unproven. Missing for 10: monthly plan prices, included scan allowances per plan, per-item fees for extra scans, forwarding/shipping fees, storage fees, check deposit fee amount, and independent corroboration.
